employee-updates-current-row-contract.text: Read contract: EmployeeRepository.GetByIdAsync LEFT JOINs employment_details filtered by end_date IS NULL (current open row) and departments; employees without an open job return HasEmploymentDetails=false. UpdateAsync detail statement only touches the open row; zero matches = no-op.

create-smart-routing.text: UI contract: EmployeeCreateViewModel.IncludeEmploymentDetails drives Create POST routing to CreateAsync vs CreateWithDetailsAsync; detail-only validation lives in IValidatableObject so base employees bypass it. View models use DateOnly + DateRangeInPast.

deferred-double-decimal.text: Task deferred: double->decimal refactor for Oracle NUMBER ids across models/repos/controllers; pre-dated all current feature code by design.

employee-soft-delete-contract.text: Delete contract: soft delete writes employees.is_deleted=1 (rows hidden by is_deleted=0 filter in GetAll/GetById); DeleteWithDetailsAsync purges employment_details then department_managers then employees in one transaction; HasDependenciesAsync sums both child counts in one scalar query. View shows destructive button only when dependencies exist, gated by checkbox + native confirm.
